scope: Profiler and compiler-report qualification under concurrent krea2-final GPU activity and system load. Not an isolated latency benchmark or speedup comparison. Five ordinary samples after three warmups, followed by three separately instrumented replays. Detailed reports collected after ordinary timing.
retained_evidence: Runtime manifest, ordinary samples, compiler identity/resources/wait reasons/diagnostics, selected detailed compiler sections, command geometry/constants/transfers, raw timestamp samples and stage distributions. Large repeated raw compiler trees are omitted; CLI commands reproduce full reports.

configured_manifest.revision: HRX 244cd3801b; native libamdf; related diagnostics and bank reports; qualified LDS overlap; Ubuntu 26.04

runtime.scope: Configured bundle identity; overrides may replace loaded libraries. Compilation records identify the actual compiler by digest.

profile.measurement_relationship: Separate instrumented replays after ordinary timing; no subtraction relationship with ordinary host latency. Replay host intervals enclose GPU execution and timestamp harvest; graph preparation, query encoding and neighbor decoding are excluded.
warnings: Timestamp markers and completion barriers perturb dispatch timing; these are not hardware utilization or stall counters.
Native timestamp storage is diagnostic overhead outside workspace budgets.
